a.jlantz: After 10 days of war, T-F9 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Nils "Ghost" Jlantz.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F9 and grazed Nils "Ghost" Jlantz's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Jakub "Ash" Baron of the Concord (@butter_baron468). The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Nils "Ghost" Jlantz helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Nils "Ghost" Jlantz rejoined the squad at T-F9. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
On dawn watch at T-F9, Nils "Ghost" Jlantz fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Dorian "Lucky" Xmb, now grazed.
The parcel for Nils "Ghost" Jlantz contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Nils "Ghost" Jlantz polishes his buttons every evening. Today, under fire at Saint-Ash crossroads, that habit was the only steady thing in T-F9.
Nils "Ghost" Jlantz stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of T-F9, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
andrewp3rillo: The draft reached N-F9 on Day 11. Gustav Rillo was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into N-F9. Gustav Rillo has learned to walk bent double.
Gustav Rillo and Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Gustav Rillo borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Gustav Rillo has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Gustav Rillo waited for that to change. When it did, Silas "Hollow" Zachbutler was gravely wounded. Gustav Rillo fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Walter Evaglane, now badly wounded.
The dugout has begun inventing endings to Gustav Rillo's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing.
ez.squared: Gustav Squared was a tram conductor in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to S-S11 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.

Gustav Squared sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. A letter from home reached Gustav Squared before dusk. Gustav Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav Squared shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. A letter from home reached Gustav Squared before dusk. Gustav Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav Squared kept Bastian Szko awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Gustav could have walked there blind. A letter from home reached Gustav Squared before dusk. Gustav Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-S11. Gustav Squared has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home reached Gustav Squared before dusk. Gustav Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.

A sniper's bullet hit Gustav Squared at S-S11. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Gustav Squared fell at S-S11 and never moved again. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla).

Hugo "Bones" Squared put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Gustav Squared helped clear the shelf without saying why. Hugo "Bones" Squared got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 447. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Hugo "Bones" Squared wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Emil Szko cut Hugo "Bones" Squared's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home reached Hugo "Bones" Squared before dusk. Hugo "Bones" Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.

A patient at the aid post asked Hugo "Bones" Squared for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. A letter from home reached Hugo "Bones" Squared before dusk. Hugo "Bones" Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet grazed Hugo "Bones" Squared's ribs at S-S11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. A letter from home reached Hugo "Bones" Squared before dusk. Hugo "Bones" Squared read it twice and slept a little easier.
Hugo "Bones" Squared tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.

For days Hugo "Bones" Squared was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Hugo "Bones" Squared anyway. Hugo "Bones" Squared transferred to the riflemans. The men in S-S11 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
femgoobert: Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert introduced himself as a brewer from Varenne. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F5. Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert has learned to walk bent double.

Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert cut Dietrich Muzio's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Frost made each footprint distinct. Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it.
Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert and Roland Lesyk carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.

Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert had just lit a cigarette at Q-F5 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Tobias Stnmz of the Hegemony (@thomas.stnmz).
Back on the fire step at Q-F5. Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
jakubwilkuu: Benedikt Jakubwilkuu came up the line in the rain with a stub of a pencil and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
The field cooks took Benedikt Jakubwilkuu in on a wet morning in S-F15. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu came off watch unable to remember whether the last hour had been long or short. He remembered every movement in one patch of wire.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F15 and grazed Benedikt Jakubwilkuu's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony (@hellcat34106). Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Benedikt Jakubwilkuu could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) and Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at the Chalk Pits. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

A man asked Benedikt Jakubwilkuu to describe Esterhaus without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Jakubwilkuu. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu and Tobias Noirangelfan sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu was carrying water up to S-F15 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu did not. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921).
Someone moved Benedikt Jakubwilkuu's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.

The medics would not give up on Benedikt Jakubwilkuu. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F15 today. Blackwater Canal is lost. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Benedikt Jakubwilkuu on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Jakubwilkuu. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 103. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet clipped Benedikt Jakubwilkuu's helmet at S-F15 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Matthias "Brick" Scuffx of the Hegemony (@scuffx28). Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Jakubwilkuu. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu returned to S-F15 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Jakubwilkuu. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Benedikt Jakubwilkuu. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet found Benedikt Jakubwilkuu at S-F15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_). Benedikt Jakubwilkuu was killed at S-F15 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Quentin Nieuwenhuis of the Hegemony (@gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_).
Another member of the House of Jakubwilkuu reached the line: Edmund "Smokes" Jakubwilkuu. He asked where Benedikt Jakubwilkuu had slept, then chose a different corner.

Edmund "Smokes" Jakubwilkuu was on watch at S-F15 when the night raid hit. The men found Edmund "Smokes" Jakubwilkuu at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Teodor Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti).
The House of Jakubwilkuu sent another. Karel Jakubwilkuu, brother of Edmund "Smokes" Jakubwilkuu, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
jimhotrod_6683: The new sapper is Zeno Jimhotrod, once a schoolteacher from Lindenbruck. The corporal asked if a schoolteacher was any use in a trench. Zeno Jimhotrod said he would find out.

Zeno Jimhotrod had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Grey Mill has been won. Zeno Jimhotrod listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Zeno Jimhotrod measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
A bullet went through Zeno Jimhotrod's sleeve at Q-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Benedikt Lutheranapol of the Concord (@lutheranapologist).
Zeno Jimhotrod walked back up the communication trench to Q-F5, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Zeno Jimhotrod was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.

Zeno Jimhotrod was hit in the foot through his boot at Q-F5. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Felix Lesyk of the Concord (@eh_its_lesyk). Zeno Jimhotrod was laid on a stretcher at the end of a long row outside the aid post. The bearers chalked a number on his boot.
kerem_ozsezgin: Hugo Ozsezgin reported to R-C7 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Hugo Ozsezgin wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Hugo Ozsezgin saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. The clerk counted the names twice. Hugo Ozsezgin is number 629 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Hugo Ozsezgin helped stack spare sandbags at R-C7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Hugo Ozsezgin ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.'
Hugo Ozsezgin kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Hugo Ozsezgin found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
A newspaper reached Hugo Ozsezgin with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
A loose thread in Hugo Ozsezgin's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
kil.lakam20: Tobias Lakam walked into S-F21 on Day 5 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Tobias Lakam tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Lakam watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Dawn watch. Tobias Lakam put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Valentin Helpmed, grazed.
Tobias Lakam and Isidor Jacksondeehr made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

Tobias Lakam was hit in the forearm at S-F21. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Bastian "Crow" Jwger of the Hegemony (@jwger87).
Tobias Lakam walked back up the communication trench to S-F21, slower than before, but on his own feet.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F21 they left Tobias Lakam behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Felix "Bones" Kurlkale of the Hegemony (@kurlkale).
Dorian Lakam had heard about Tobias Lakam's courage. At S-F21, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Dorian Lakam approved the method. The clerk counted the names twice. Dorian Lakam is number 333 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Dorian Lakam looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dorian Lakam had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames crossed it, Dorian Lakam fired. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames was gravely wounded.

A bullet hit Dorian Lakam in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F21. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420). Dorian Lakam looked over the parapet at S-F21 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420).
Silas Lakam took the same post at S-F21 where Dorian Lakam stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
An empty jam tin became Silas Lakam's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
A bullet found Silas Lakam at S-F21, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Casimir "Whistle" Chrisoostuiz of the Hegemony (@chrisoostuizen).
For days Silas Lakam was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
montblackz_: Severin Montblackz arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in Q-F5 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Severin Montblackz. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home reached Severin Montblackz before dusk. Severin Montblackz read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Severin Montblackz folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Severin Montblackz tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. A letter from home reached Severin Montblackz before dusk. Severin Montblackz read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet went through Severin Montblackz's sleeve at Q-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Pavel "Lucky" Tawt of the Concord (@tawt_us). A letter from home reached Severin Montblackz before dusk. Severin Montblackz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Severin Montblackz is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Severin Montblackz before dusk. Severin Montblackz read it twice and slept a little easier.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Severin Montblackz held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Severin Montblackz called across from the Hegemony line. Roland Lammyswashy answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. Severin Montblackz found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Severin Montblackz read it while the kettle boiled.
seanlively95: Edmund Seanlively walked into S-R5 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Edmund Seanlively listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet clipped Edmund Seanlively's helmet at S-R5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars). Victory at Grey Mill. Edmund Seanlively let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The wound on Edmund Seanlively's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
A supply man offered Edmund Seanlively a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Edmund Seanlively of the Hegemony and Florian Adauto of the Concord watched a broken branch near Saint-Ash crossroads all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Edmund Seanlively counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Dorian "Ash" Juanito was grazed.
Edmund Seanlively fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-R5. Severin "Bones" Tylermontygr was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
sneedhomelstent: The draft reached W-F8 on Day 16. Marek Sneedhomelst was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
tio_coiote: Bastian Coiote walked into T-F18 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

A bullet hit Bastian Coiote's belt buckle at T-F18 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Albin "Mole" Bricky of the Concord (@bricky_ua). A letter from home found Bastian Coiote before the night shift. Bastian Coiote folded it small and kept it close. Bastian Coiote walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Bastian Coiote's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home found Bastian Coiote before the night shift. Bastian Coiote folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian Coiote (Hegemony) and Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Hill 304 for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. A letter from home found Bastian Coiote before the night shift. Bastian Coiote folded it small and kept it close.

Wiring party. Bastian Coiote held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at T-F18, and everyone came back. A letter from home found Bastian Coiote before the night shift. Bastian Coiote folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian Coiote began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A letter from home found Bastian Coiote before the night shift. Bastian Coiote folded it small and kept it close.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Bastian Coiote was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Bastian Coiote was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a photograph gone soft at the edges. Bastian Coiote got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
ttable4one: The new lieutenant is Valentin One, once a fisherman from Halden. The corporal asked if a fisherman was any use in a trench. Valentin One said he would find out.
